settings.subtext: Posture correctors, deep-tissue massagers and targeted pain-relief tools — precision-crafted so you can move, perform and recover at your best.

settings.header_desc: Every product in the VexoraCare range targets a real problem — poor posture, stubborn tension or persistent pain — with smart, body-first engineering.
settings.c1_body: Retrain your spine and build better muscle memory. Worn invisibly under clothing, our posture range reduces slouching and relieves neck and upper-back strain within weeks.
settings.c2_body: Percussive therapy, heated massage and targeted vibration tools. Break down lactic acid, ease tension knots and speed up muscle recovery — on your schedule.
settings.c3_body: TENS therapy, heat wraps and smart compression — drug-free relief that targets the source of chronic back, joint and nerve pain rather than masking it.
settings.bl1: Reduces back pain in as little as 2 weeks
settings.br1: Suitable for all ages & fitness levels
